review:
Big Bass in a boxing gym, with double collectors. Three, four or five scatters give 15, 20 or 25 free spins – more than most Big Bass games start with.

In the bonus, fish worth up to 5,000x can be collected by either a blue or a red wild, and each colour has its own meter: every fourth wild of a colour adds 10 spins and raises that colour's multiplier to 2x, 3x, then 10x. Two tracks to watch at once. 96.5% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
